boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Illinois State spaces for studying, making, gathering, recreation, and campus culture, supported by current university sources.

cards.title: The Quad
cards.subtitle: Central campus outdoor gathering space
cards.notes: Bring a book or meet a classmate beneath the trees; use the open lawn as a daytime pause between nearby academic buildings.
cards.short_summary: A historic campus focal point for informal activity and outdoor study.
cards.evidence_claim: Illinois State describes the Quad as a popular meeting point that hosts planned and spontaneous activities and supports quiet study.
cards.source_title: The Quad | Illinois State Traditions
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus space; check university event scheduling before planning a group activity.

cards.title: Bone Student Center lounges
cards.subtitle: 200 N. University Street
cards.notes: Choose a lounge for a study break, conversation, or a meal; private huddle rooms are available through Career Services reservations.
cards.short_summary: A student-center hub with lounges intended for studying, relaxing, socializing, and dining.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bone Student Center says every floor has lounges for studying, relaxing, socializing, or dining, and offers reservable student huddle rooms.
cards.source_title: Bone Student Center | Illinois State University
cards.access_notes: Lounges are described as open to anyone; huddle rooms require reservation through Career Services.

cards.title: Milner Library open study areas
cards.subtitle: 201 N. School Street
cards.notes: Set up at an open table or carrel when you want to work solo or alongside others, then use library computers or printing if needed.
cards.short_summary: Six floors of library space combine open tables, study facilities, and campus technology.
cards.evidence_claim: Milner Library offers individual and group study facilities, including open tables on Floor 3, plus computers, printers, scanners, and a 3D printer.
cards.source_title: About Milner Library | Illinois State University
cards.access_notes: Use during library open hours; follow library policies and check floor maps for available facilities.

cards.entity_name: Milner Library Group Study Rooms and Pods
cards.title: Milner group study rooms and pods
cards.subtitle: Milner Library Floors 4–5
cards.notes: Bring a small project group and use a room or pod for discussion; whiteboards and, in pods, monitors support shared work.
cards.short_summary: Dedicated small-group spaces for collaborative coursework and project discussion.
cards.evidence_claim: Milner’s group study rooms and pods are for small groups to study or discuss projects; rooms have whiteboards and pods add monitors and adjustable lights.
cards.source_title: Group Study Rooms | Milner Library | Illinois State University
cards.access_notes: Available to students, faculty, and staff on a first-come, first-served basis; group-size guidelines apply.

cards.title: Milner drop-in offices
cards.subtitle: Milner Library Floor 4 quiet floor
cards.notes: Bring a USB-C laptop when you need a larger display and desk space; head to the 422 or 429 office blocks to focus.
cards.short_summary: Office-style workstations on Milner’s designated quiet floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Milner’s Floor 4 Drop-in Offices provide an office-like setting with a 24-inch monitor, whiteboard, desk space, and power hookups.
cards.source_title: Drop-in Offices | Milner Library | Illinois State University
cards.access_notes: Located in the northeast and southeast corners of Floor 4, in the 422 and 429 office blocks.

cards.title: Make It Space
cards.subtitle: Milner Library Floor 2 south stairwell
cards.notes: Use the listed self-service tools to finish a project, then ask at the Service Desk about supplies or equipment instructions.
cards.short_summary: A library making area with project tools and multimedia workstations.
cards.evidence_claim: Milner’s Make It Space offers first-come, first-served equipment and multimedia computers; its tools are near the Floor 2 south stairwell.
cards.source_title: Make It Space | Milner Library | Illinois State University
cards.access_notes: Equipment, multimedia computers, and the Ready Record Studio are first-come, first-served when the library is open.

cards.title: The Gathering Space
cards.subtitle: Multicultural Center, 301 S. Main Street
cards.notes: Use the tables, lounge seating, and collaboration station for a relaxed work session, conversation, or a pause during a busy day.
cards.short_summary: The Multicultural Center’s primary shared area for lounging, studying, and collaborating.
cards.evidence_claim: Illinois State identifies The Gathering Space as the Multicultural Center’s primary area for lounging, studying, relaxing, and collaborating.
cards.source_title: Spaces | Multicultural Center | Illinois State University
cards.access_notes: The center’s spaces may have reservations or programming; consult the center before planning a group use.

cards.title: University Galleries
cards.subtitle: Uptown Station, 11 Uptown Circle, Suite 103
cards.notes: Walk through the current exhibition or arrange a tour; it is a short off-campus stop in Uptown Normal near transit.
cards.short_summary: Illinois State’s contemporary-art exhibition space in Uptown Normal.
cards.evidence_claim: University Galleries states that all exhibitions and events are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Visit the Galleries | University Galleries | Illinois State University
cards.access_notes: Check the gallery’s posted seasonal hours before visiting; all exhibitions and events are free and open to the public.

cards.entity_name: Student Fitness Center and McCormick Hall
cards.title: Student Fitness Center and McCormick Hall
cards.subtitle: West end of the Quad near S. University and Dry Grove
cards.notes: Use a campus recreation visit for a workout, court time, or a facility orientation; stop at the welcome center for tour information.
cards.short_summary: A 170,000-square-foot recreation and wellness complex at the west end of the Quad.
cards.evidence_claim: Illinois State identifies this 170,000-square-foot complex as home to Campus Recreation, Health Promotion and Wellness, and the School of Kinesiology and Recreation.
cards.source_title: Student Fitness Center & McCormick Hall | Campus Recreation | Illinois State University
cards.access_notes: Facility access and tours are managed by Campus Recreation; consult membership and building-hours information before visiting.

cards.title: Redbird Adventure Center
cards.subtitle: 1700 Gregory Street
cards.notes: Plan an outdoor trip, ask about equipment rentals, or use the resource center to map out your own outing with a group.
cards.short_summary: The operational base for Illinois State’s outdoor adventure programs and rentals.
cards.evidence_claim: The Redbird Adventure Center includes outdoor equipment rentals, a resource center, meeting room, patio, and high ropes course.
cards.source_title: Redbird Adventure Center | Campus Recreation | Illinois State University
cards.access_notes: Equipment rentals and adventure activities have Campus Recreation procedures; verify availability and requirements before going.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct Milner Library study environments, each with a documented setup or access constraint.

cards.entity_name: Milner Library Floor 3 Open Study Space
cards.title: Floor 3 Open Study Space
cards.subtitle: Milner Library · Floor 3
cards.notes: Set up at a large table, carrel, or desk chair for solo work or a small group session; Floor 3 is Milner’s largest open study area.
cards.short_summary: A flexible open-floor option with multiple seating formats.
cards.evidence_claim: Milner identifies Floor 3 as its large open study area and lists tables, study carrels, and desk chairs among its general-study furnishings.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces | Milner Library | Illinois State
cards.access_notes: General study is available throughout Milner; the library identifies Floor 3 as the large open area.

cards.title: The Quiet Floor
cards.subtitle: Milner Library · Floor 4
cards.notes: Choose Floor 4 when you need a lower-distraction setting, then bring headphones and keep conversations elsewhere to respect the designated quiet use.
cards.short_summary: A whole floor designated for distraction-reduced studying.
cards.evidence_claim: Milner Library designates Floor 4 as a Quiet Floor for patrons who want to study without distractions.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces | Milner Library | Illinois State
cards.access_notes: Floor 4 is designated as a Quiet Floor; use is subject to library access.

cards.entity_name: Milner Library Floor 4 Quiet Study Rooms
cards.title: Floor 4 Quiet Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Milner Library · Rooms 420A–431B
cards.notes: Bring a two-to-four-person group and use a private room’s whiteboard to outline a project, then clear your materials before leaving.
cards.short_summary: Private small-group rooms on Milner’s quiet floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Milner lists quiet group study rooms on Floor 4 and states that private group study rooms have whiteboards.
cards.source_title: Group Study Rooms & Pods | Milner Library | Illinois State
cards.access_notes: First come, first served; available to students, faculty, and staff for groups of two to four.

cards.entity_name: Milner Library Floor 5 Group Study Rooms
cards.title: Floor 5 Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Milner Library · Rooms 520A, 520B, 531A, 531B
cards.notes: Use one of the named Floor 5 rooms for a focused project meeting; bring at least one partner and use the room’s whiteboard for planning.
cards.short_summary: Four named small-group rooms on Floor 5.
cards.evidence_claim: Milner identifies group study rooms 520A, 520B, 531A, and 531B on Floor 5; private group study rooms include whiteboards.
cards.source_title: Group Study Rooms & Pods | Milner Library | Illinois State
cards.access_notes: First come, first served; group-study rooms are for two to four students, faculty, or staff at a time.

cards.entity_name: Milner Library Floor 5 Group Study Pods
cards.title: Floor 5 Group Study Pods
cards.subtitle: Milner Library · Northeast and northwest corners
cards.notes: Gather a small team in a glass-enclosed pod for a shared screen session, then adjust the lights and use the whiteboard to keep tasks visible.
cards.short_summary: Glass-enclosed pods equipped for compact group work.
cards.evidence_claim: Milner’s Floor 5 group study pods have whiteboards, monitors, and adjustable lights.
cards.source_title: Group Study Rooms & Pods | Milner Library | Illinois State
cards.access_notes: First come, first served; pods are for groups of two to five students, faculty, or staff.

cards.title: Floor 5 Study Booths
cards.subtitle: Milner Library · Northwest corner
cards.notes: Take an individual booth for reading or drafting when you want visual separation without needing a silent or soundproof room.
cards.short_summary: Individual booths for concentrated one-person work.
cards.evidence_claim: Milner provides individual study booths on Floor 5 for a quiet, though not soundproof, one-person study environment.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces | Milner Library | Illinois State
cards.access_notes: Individual booths are located on Floor 5; use is subject to library access.

cards.entity_name: Milner Library Floor 6 Soundproof Study Booth
cards.title: Floor 6 Soundproof Booth
cards.subtitle: Milner Library · Floor 6
cards.notes: Use the single soundproof booth for an individual session that benefits from acoustic separation; have a backup plan because Milner lists only one.
cards.short_summary: Milner’s single completely soundproof individual booth.
cards.evidence_claim: Milner Library states that one completely soundproof study booth is available on Floor 6.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces | Milner Library | Illinois State
cards.access_notes: One soundproof booth is available on Floor 6; use is subject to library access.

cards.title: Floor 3 Collaboration Stations
cards.subtitle: Milner Library · Floor 3 east side
cards.notes: Connect a laptop or mobile device to a 43-inch shared monitor and use nearby whiteboards to make a group work session more visible.
cards.short_summary: Shared-screen stations for groups of five to six.
cards.evidence_claim: Six Floor 3 collaboration stations sit along the east side of the open study space; many are surrounded by whiteboards, and stations seat groups of five to six.
cards.source_title: Collaboration Stations | Milner Library | Illinois State
cards.access_notes: Connect with HDMI or USB-C; the library says no software, adapters, or configuration are required.

cards.title: Floor 4 Drop-in Offices
cards.subtitle: Milner Library · 422 and 429 office blocks
cards.notes: Plug a compatible laptop into the USB-C monitor for keyboard, video, mouse, and power, then use the desk and whiteboard for independent work.
cards.short_summary: Office-style individual workspaces with a wired monitor setup.
cards.evidence_claim: Milner’s Floor 4 Drop-in Offices provide a 24-inch USB-C monitor, keyboard, mouse, whiteboard, desk space, and power hookups.
cards.source_title: Drop-in Offices | Milner Library | Illinois State
cards.access_notes: Located in the northeast and southeast corners of Floor 4 in the 422 and 429 office blocks; designed for compatible USB-C laptops.

cards.title: Milner Computer Workstations
cards.subtitle: Milner Library · Floors 2–6
cards.notes: Choose a first-come workstation when coursework needs campus software; use the specialty stations in 213B for low-vision, audio, or visual work.
cards.short_summary: Library computers with broad software and specialty options.
cards.evidence_claim: Milner provides Windows workstations on Floors 2 through 6 on a first-come, first-served basis, with specialty workstations in Room 213B.
cards.source_title: Library Workstations | Milner Library | Illinois State
cards.access_notes: Workstations are first come, first served. Non-university users must check in at the main-floor Service Desk.
